missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Производство' is a neuter noun in the nominative as the subject of 'выросло', which agrees in neuter gender. 'В этом году' sets the time. A clean economic statement.

Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Производство' is neuter, so its accusative matches the nominative form. 'Увеличил' takes it as the direct object, and 'автомобилей' is a genitive complement. Useful business language.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Производства' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express that something is lacking. 'Своего' agrees in the neuter genitive. A core negation pattern.

Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В производство' uses the accusative after 'в' to mark where the money goes. 'Вложила' agrees with the feminine subject 'компания'. Practical for finance talk.

missions.phrase: Он работает на производстве десять лет.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'На производстве' uses the prepositional form 'производстве' after 'на' to mark the workplace. 'Десять лет' gives the duration. A common employment phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after a short adjective. 'Производством' is the instrumental required by 'довольно', which expresses satisfaction with something. A useful evaluative pattern.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О производстве' uses the prepositional after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Новом' agrees in the neuter prepositional. A natural discussion frame.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Производства' is the nominative plural subject of 'работают'. 'Крупные' agrees in the plural, and 'в городе' locates them. A simple plural model.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Производств' is the genitive plural after 'много', formed without an ending. 'Вредных' agrees in the genitive plural. A useful quantity pattern.

Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Производство' is nominative as the subject. 'Современное' is the agreeing neuter adjective, and 'эффективно' is the short-form predicate intensified by 'очень'. A clean descriptive card.
